checked_scope: The factor one-half interaction bound, its sharpness, and the displayed mixed-derivative bound for equilibrium equations.
checks: Adding predecessors one by one gives mixed-derivative rectangle integrals bounded by Mₖₗ||zₖ||||zₗ||; each l precedes k in exactly half of permutations.
